scope: Manager-operated Job Management activation: planned visits, office costing and completion reports; employee self-service UI deferred per current owner roster direction

checks.includes: Realistic linked-appointment lifecycle, three visits, deposit/change/final balance and retry, scoped backend permissions, office costs and completion snapshots. The browser fixture uses business-local dates and a current past start so completion tests remain valid overnight.
Merged current beta source, TypeScript, Vite and preview isolation.

visual.pdf: Synthetic completion PDF rendered and visually inspected; long/Unicode/photo pagination test passed. Legacy WebP metadata with normalized PNG/JPEG bytes is accepted without changing the retained source.
visual.browser: Shared Chrome inspected the 390px phone fixture and native date controls. Saving a future visit with its own crew visibly produced two open visits. This is synthetic browser acceptance, not an authenticated tenant or physical iPhone test.

database.source_history: Canonical migration filenames now use the actual already-applied ledger versions; statements and hosted ledger were not edited or reapplied to align timestamps.

security_advisors.note: WARN counts returned to the previous baseline after privileged implementations moved behind private invoker-wrapped APIs. Five additional private deny-direct tables account for INFO-only RLS-no-policy entries.

performance_advisors.note: The separate ordinary-staff/field allow policies remain intentionally combined by PostgreSQL OR semantics and restrictive module/receipt rules. Optional consolidation was canceled and not applied. No load/capacity certificate is claimed.

database.optional_followups: Policy consolidation and additional pending-field-account scope requests were canceled and confirmed unapplied. Their uncommitted source was removed. Existing linked-field protections are retained; employee UI/accounts are not activated.

cost.note: Reuses current Supabase storage/upload quotas and existing PDF dependencies. Pro five total account seats and separate worker-profile limits retained. Hosting, database, storage and bandwidth remain subject to existing usage charges.

limits: Owner-selected manager roster requires no worker login, invitation or notification; employee self-service remains deferred and no field accounts were retained.
The permission test simulates database authenticated roles against the real beta schema; it does not certify actual account sign-in, physical devices or external services.
Actual Storage upload/camera, provider delivery/payment, two-tenant browser sessions and measured concurrency/load remain under their open acceptance gates.
No customer message, real card charge/refund, new paid service, new account seat, or production-backend promotion was performed.

preparation.original_database_state: First approval expired and second was canceled; no migrations had applied then. The user subsequently approved retry/activation.
preparation.employee_frontend: Original field self-service source remains recoverable at the original head. Current manager release excludes its pages, controls, mandatory sign-in RPC and new field invitations.

retained_regressions.note: Passed in the prepared implementation before the later beta integration; current upstream full-suite acceptance remains recorded separately in PR71. Do not infer that the full upstream browser suite was rerun for this change.
